subject: HANDOFF ticket07: public dual-display primitives exist; Fold7 inner+cover concurrency and secondary input remain physical-evidence gated
body: READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW. Three research cycles complete. Current HEAD 7127c287 still hosts TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY content through WindowManager.addView in FoldSurface; no direct API-34 attachAccessibilityOverlayToDisplay call was found in current source. Android publicly supports Presentation on suitable app-visible secondary displays and API-34 direct accessibility SurfaceControl attachment to a specified logical display; current display APIs also expose built-in-display enumeration. None of those contracts guarantees Samsung concurrently publishes, powers, composites, or routes touch for both Fold7 internal panels. Final report provides a privacy-safe physical matrix: topology/publication first; distinct Presentation/direct-overlay markers with external-camera proof; then secondary digitizer attribution by receiving display-bound View/Context plus InputDevice metadata, never numeric deviceId alone. No production writes.
